title.zh: Windows 平台 Wintun 驱动故障修复指南：驱动签名失效、适配器被占用与服务启动报错
title.en: Windows Wintun Driver Repair Handbook: Driver Signature Errors, Stale Adapters & Service Failures

cluster.zh: TUN 虚拟网卡深度分流

description.zh: 面向 Windows 10 与 11 用户的 Wintun 虚拟网卡底层驱动排障权威指南。深入修复【无法创建 Wintun 适配器】、旧版 OpenVPN 驱动残留冲突、驱动强制签名阻断与系统注册表清理方法。
description.en: Authoritative diagnostic and repair guide for Windows Wintun virtual network drivers. Resolves adapter initialization errors, driver signature enforcement bugs, OpenVPN driver collisions, and stale registry entries.
